Other prayers
Pray these like nafl, two rakats at a time, with a surah after Al-Fatiha in every rakat. Follow the Fajr steps for each pair.
Intention (niyyah)
Face the qibla. In your heart, intend which prayer you are praying and how many rakats. Saying it out loud is not required.
Opening takbir
Raise both hands to your ears, thumbs touching the earlobes and palms facing the qibla, and say the takbir.
Raise both hands to your shoulders, kept inside your dupatta, and say the takbir.
Fold hands, recite Thana
Fold your hands below the navel, right hand over the left, holding the left wrist. Look at the place of sajdah and recite Thana.
Place your hands on your chest, right palm over the back of the left hand. Look at the place of sajdah and recite Thana.
Extra takbirs
Say takbir three times, raising your hands to the ears each time and letting them drop to your sides. After the third, fold them again.
After the surah, say takbir three times with hands raised and dropped. The fourth takbir is said without raising the hands as you go into ruku.
Seek refuge
Quietly seek refuge with Allah before reciting the Quran.
Al-Fatiha
Say Bismillah quietly, recite Al-Fatiha, then say Ameen quietly.
Stand up straight for this rakat. Say Bismillah quietly, recite Al-Fatiha, then say Ameen quietly.
Recite only Al-Fatiha in this rakat. No surah is added in this rakat of a farz prayer.
Stand up for this rakat and recite only Al-Fatiha. No surah is added in this rakat of a farz prayer.
Add a surah
Recite any surah or at least three short verses. Al-Ikhlas is shown as an example.
Dua Qunoot
After the surah of the third rakat, say takbir raising your hands to the ears, fold them again below the navel and recite Dua Qunoot.
After the surah of the third rakat, say takbir raising your hands to the shoulders, place them on the chest again and recite Dua Qunoot.
Ruku
Say takbir and bow. Grip your knees with fingers spread, keep your back and head level and your arms away from your sides.
Say takbir and bow a little, only enough for the hands to reach the knees. Keep the fingers together on the knees and the arms close to the body.
Say takbir and bow forward from where you sit, hands on the knees.
Say takbir and bow forward a little from the chair, hands on the knees.
Rise from ruku
Stand up straight saying the first phrase, then say the second once you are upright. Pause for a moment.
Sit up straight saying the first phrase, then say the second. Pause for a moment.
Sajdah
Say takbir and go down: knees, then hands, then nose and forehead between the hands. Keep the arms away from the sides, elbows off the ground, toes bent towards the qibla.
Say takbir and go down into a compact sajdah: belly against the thighs, arms close to the body and forearms on the ground.
Say takbir and bow for sajdah. If you can, put the forehead on the ground. If you cannot, bow the head lower than you did for ruku.
Say takbir and bow lower than you did for ruku. Do not lift anything up to the forehead to touch it.
Sit between the sajdahs
Say takbir and sit on the left foot with the right foot upright, toes towards the qibla, hands on the thighs. Pause for a moment.
Say takbir and sit on the left hip with both feet out to the right side, hands on the thighs. Pause for a moment.
Say takbir and sit up straight on the chair, hands on the thighs. Pause for a moment.
Second sajdah
Say takbir and make the second sajdah the same way as the first.
First sitting
After the second rakat, sit as between the sajdahs and recite only At-Tahiyyat. Raise the right index finger at “la ilaha” and lower it at “illallah”. Then say takbir and stand up.
Final sitting
Sit after the last rakat and recite At-Tahiyyat (raising the finger as before), then Durood, then a dua.
Salam to the right
Turn your face to the right, looking at your shoulder, and say the salam.
Salam to the left
Turn your face to the left and say the salam again. The prayer is complete.
First takbir
Janazah is prayed standing, with no ruku, sajdah or sitting. Raise the hands to the ears, say takbir, fold them below the navel and recite Thana.
Janazah is prayed standing, with no ruku, sajdah or sitting. Raise the hands to the shoulders, say takbir, place them on the chest and recite Thana.
Second takbir
Say takbir without raising the hands, then recite Durood Ibrahim.
Third takbir
Say takbir without raising the hands, then recite the dua for the deceased.
Fourth takbir
Say takbir without raising the hands, recite nothing after it, then give salam to both sides.

string-array.item: 2 to 8 rakats. Last part of the night, after waking from sleep.
20 rakats in Ramadan, after Isha and before Witr.
2 to 4 rakats, about 20 minutes after sunrise.
2 to 12 rakats, from mid-morning until before zawal.
2 rakats on entering the masjid, before sitting down.
2 rakats, then the Istikhara dua, when deciding on a matter.
4 rakats with the tasbih recited 300 times in all.
